_note: NAV, the ark's navigation computer: dry, factual, no feelings (a TARS-like role, its own lines). Numbers in {braces} are filled in by NavAdvisor. Line ids are fixed; the text may be rewritten freely. Voice: assets/audio/vo/nav_<id>.ogg (optional).

character.name: NAV
character.bio: The navigation computer. Speaks in numbers and probabilities. Has no opinion on whether you should be afraid.

route_clear.text: Route to {dest}: {days} days in stasis. No known obstacles on the approach.

route_field.text: The approach to {dest} has scattered asteroids. Expected: {hits_manual} impacts on manual control, {hits_auto} on autopilot. The autopilot uses {fuel_auto} extra units of fuel.

route_debris.text: The approach to {dest} passes a debris field. Expected hull loss: {integ_manual} percent manual, {integ_auto} percent on autopilot.

route_belt.text: The route crosses an asteroid belt. Density: {density} percent. Expected hull loss: {integ_manual} percent manual, {integ_auto} percent on autopilot. Autopilot recommended.

route_reserve_breach.text: Reserve after arrival: {fuel_after}. To reach {reserve_target}: {reserve_needed} required. Landing is effectively final.

route_oxygen.text: Oxygen used in stasis: {oxygen} percent. Oxygen reserve on arrival: {oxygen_after} percent.

route_oxygen_low.text: Oxygen reserve on arrival: {oxygen_after} percent. That is below the recommended minimum of {low} percent.

status_fuel_low.text: Fuel: {fuel} units. Enough for {reachable} of {routes} known routes from here.

status_fuel_none.text: Fuel: {fuel} units. No known route is within range. The next decision is landing.

status_oxygen_low.text: Oxygen reserve: {oxygen} percent. Below recommended minimum. The scrubbers can be repaired in the workshop.

status_oxygen_critical.text: Oxygen reserve: {oxygen} percent. Critical. At stasis consumption, reserve lasts {days_left} days.

status_hull_low.text: Hull integrity: {integrity} percent. Further impacts increase the risk of pressure loss.

approach_clear.text: Approach initiated. No objects on course. This is rare.

approach_field.text: Approach initiated. Scattered asteroids ahead. Reduce speed to allow time to turn.

approach_debris.text: Approach initiated. Debris ahead. Fragments are small. Small is not harmless.

approach_belt.text: Approach initiated. Asteroid belt begins in {distance} meters. Autopilot recommended. This is a recommendation, not an order.

collision_course.text: Object on collision course. {seconds} seconds. Correction: {side}.

impact_severe.text: Severe impact. Pressure loss in section {section}. Oxygen reserve {oxygen} percent.

autopilot_on.text: Autopilot engaged. Additional fuel consumption: {fuel} units.

arrival.text: Orbit around {dest} established. Hull {integrity} percent. Fuel {fuel}. Oxygen {oxygen} percent.
